items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Bache used to live around that too, didn't he? ... Yeah, Sidney Bache.

ctx.x: Where did you live then, Johnny? Around the prime evening off? Oh, yeah. I lived the whole hallway around the street. You still live on Orleans? No, I don't live around that way anymore. But that was 1990. Bache used to live around that too, didn't he? Bache. Bache, he died, yeah. Yeah, Bache, yeah. I was, when I was, yeah, Sidney, yeah.

Yeah, Sidney Bache. I was working around 1910, 1911, 12. Sharky's brother-in-law, Johnny Carella, had all the camps. I was building, but Sharky was learning how to play. I used to leave him sitting on the bandstand, he was building all this. For Christ's sake, Johnny, I don't want that monkey to eat camp. I said, leave him playing.
He was playing clarinet at that time.
